The scholarship programme offers financial support of a minimum of £10,000 to students pursuing a one-year postgraduate study in the UK.
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship using the steps listed below -

After successful registration, fill in the required details, upload the necessary documents and submit.
The candidates will be shortlisted based on the fulfilment of the eligibility criteria.
Candidates must hold an offer letter to start a one-year full-time master’s course.
Candidates must take the English language test before applying to the course.
Candidates must submit their language proficiency certificate before applying to the course.
Candidates will lose the scholarships if they postpone their admissions.
This scholarship cannot be combined with any other scholarship.
Candidates who already have a fully sponsored scholarship cannot apply for this scholarship.
Successful candidates need to represent the Art University Bournemouth and the British Council as ambassador for the GREAT scheme.
